text.en: 1. This Notification is the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Designated Licensee) Notification 2025 and comes into operation on 15 April 2025.
2. The Authority designates Singapore Cruise Centre Pte. Ltd. (UEN 200301594R) as a designated licensee for the purposes of Part 13 of the Act.
